subtopic: SECOND SESSION-NINETEENTH PARLIAMENT 4-5 GEORGE VI, 1941 VOLUME I, 1941 COMPRISING THE PERIOD FROM THE SEVENTH DAY OF NOVEMBER, 1940, TO THE TWENTY-SIXTH DAY OF FEBRUARY, 1941, INCLUSIVE BEING VOLUME CCXXV FOR THE PERIOD 1875-1941 INDEX ISSUED IN A SEPARATE VOLUME OTTAWA EDMOND CLOUTIER PRINTER TO THE KING'S MOST EXCELLENT MAJESTY 1941 CANADA

speechtext: The parliament which had been prorogued on the fifth day of November, 1940, met this day at Ottawa, for the dispatch of business.
